When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

message.content:
Assuming `log` is the natural logarithm:

∫ -3 * log(x**3) dx  
= ∫ -3 * (3 * log(x)) dx  
= ∫ -9 * log(x) dx  

Using ∫ log(x) dx = x * log(x) - x:

= -9 * (x * log(x) - x) + C  
= -9 * x * log(x) + 9 * x + C

<answer>-9*x*log(x) + 9*x + C</answer>
